body:
We send an email for every order, plus another with payment details where your method needs them, and later emails when payment is confirmed and when your order ships. If you have placed an order and the email has not arrived, do not worry: it is usually a simple filtering or typing problem, and there are clear checks to find it. This guide walks through the checks in the order that solves most cases fastest, explains why emails go missing, what to do for each type of email, how to protect future messages from being filtered and how to get what you need if the email never arrives. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Which emails you should receive
It helps to know what to look for. After you place an order you should receive an order confirmation with your order ID, the items, the total and a private link to your order page. If you chose Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime or gift cards, you should also receive an email with payment details and a link to the private payment page. When payment is confirmed you receive a confirmation, and when the order ships you receive a tracking email. Emails come from our official address and always show your order ID. If you have received the first but not the second, see the section on payment-detail emails below.

## 1. Look in spam and promotions
Search your mailbox for the order ID or for "One Stop Vape Store". Check the spam or junk folder, and if you use Gmail, the Promotions and Updates tabs. If you find our message, mark it as not spam and move it to your inbox, so that future emails arrive normally. Mailbox filters sometimes treat a message from a new sender as suspicious, particularly when it contains links and a private code.

## 2. Check the address you entered
A single typo means the email goes elsewhere. Your order page, which you may still have open, shows what you submitted. Check the spelling of the domain, such as gmail.com, and the characters before the @. If it is wrong, contact us straight away with your order ID and the correct address. We will confirm your identity and resend the messages. Do not try to place the order again, because that creates a duplicate.

## 3. Wait a few minutes
Email delivery can lag, especially during busy periods or when your provider runs extra security checks. Wait ten minutes before assuming it did not send, and refresh your mailbox. If it has been much longer, move on to the next checks.

## 4. Check inbox filters and security gateways
Rules you or your employer have set can send messages to a folder or block them. Security gateways at work, school and some internet providers sometimes block commercial email or messages with links. Look at your filter rules and any blocked-sender lists. If you use a work or school address, try a personal email address for the order instead, and ask us to resend to it.

## 5. Add us to your contacts
Add our order email address to your contacts or trusted senders list. Many providers deliver messages from contacts to the inbox and are more cautious with unknown senders. After you add us, ask us to resend the email.

## 6. Use WhatsApp or the order page
If you placed an order via WhatsApp, we can send details there. Your confirmation page also has a private link that you can bookmark, so you do not depend on the email to reach your order. If you still have that page open, copy the link before you close it. The page shows the status, the amount due and payment instructions where relevant. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## 7. Contact us
Reach us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID, or with the time and amount of your order and the name you used. We can resend the confirmation, the payment details or the private link. Our customer service hours are Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. See [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/).

## For payment-detail emails
These come after you order for Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime and gift cards. They are sent as soon as the order is saved, usually within minutes in business hours, but they can take longer outside those hours. If the first email arrived but the payment-detail email did not, check the same places, and then contact us. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/). Do not pay until you have received details from us, and never pay to details sent by anyone else.

## For tracking emails
A tracking email arrives after your order is processed and shipped. If your status shows shipped on your order page but you have no tracking email, check spam, and contact us with your order ID. We can resend the tracking number. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## Why emails go missing
- **Typos** in the address.
- **Spam filters** treating a new sender as suspicious.
- **Full inboxes** that cannot accept new messages.
- **Work or school gateways** that block commercial messages.
- **Forwarding rules** that send mail somewhere you do not look.
- **Provider delays** during busy periods.

Understanding the cause helps you fix it once, so that every future email arrives.

## How to protect future emails
Add our address to your contacts, mark our messages as not spam, avoid using a work address for personal orders and keep enough space in your mailbox. If you use several addresses, use the one you check most often. When you place an order, double-check the address you type.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Should I place the order again if the email did not arrive?
Please do not. A second order would be a duplicate. Contact us first, and we will find the first order and resend the email.

### Can you send the details to a different address?
Yes. Contact us from the address on the order, or give us the details of the order, and we will confirm your identity and update the address.

### I deleted the email by mistake.
Contact us with your order ID and we will resend it, or open your private order page if you saved the link.

### Why did I receive an email about an order I did not place?
Someone may have mistyped your address. Do not click links in messages you did not expect, and contact us with the order ID so we can sort it out.

## What we never ask for in email
We never ask for passwords, PINs, card numbers, private keys or recovery phrases. If an email claiming to be from us asks for them, do not respond, and tell us. See [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/).

## Related
Learn the usual timeline in [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) and the meaning of each step in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A worked example
You place an order at 2:15pm and choose Chime. By 2:30pm you have an order confirmation but not the payment details. You check spam and find nothing. You open the private order page from the confirmation email, and it says payment details will be sent. You wait ten minutes, then message us on WhatsApp with your order ID. A team member replies that the payment-detail email was sent and bounced because of a typo in an earlier attempt, resends it and also sends the details in chat. You pay, upload a screenshot and the order moves on. The delay was a few minutes, and the fix was simple, because you had your order ID and the private link.

## Keeping a backup
After any order, take a moment to save your order ID somewhere other than your email, such as a note on your phone, and bookmark the private order link. If an email goes missing, you can still reach your order, and we can find it in seconds. A backup costs nothing and saves worry.

## What to do if you do not use email much
If email is not your usual channel, tell us when you order and ask us to send details by WhatsApp. Your private order page also gives you everything you need to follow the order, and you can bookmark it on your phone. When you place the order, copy the order ID into your notes. With those two things, you do not depend on an inbox, and you can reach us quickly with the information we need.

## Mailboxes that are often problematic
Some free and regional email services filter more aggressively than others, and some corporate and school addresses block messages from senders they have not seen before. If you have had trouble receiving messages from online shops in the past, use a different address for your order, or add us to your contacts before you check out. A major webmail service with a strong spam filter that you check daily is usually the most reliable choice.
